response.justification: Bogdan is a technically strong and versatile individual-contributor engineer with deep experience in developer tooling, testing frameworks, and CI/CD, which aligns well with the 'engineering productivity' focus area. However, the role is fundamentally a people-management position requiring 2+ years of direct people management/team leadership experience, regular one-on-ones, and organizational change leadership, none of which appear anywhere in his 15+ year history of purely IC titles (Software/Senior/Staff Developer). There is no evidence of managing reports, performance reviews, or organizational roadmap ownership, making this a poor fit despite strong technical credentials.
strengths: Deep experience building developer tools, test runners (Trial), and testing libraries (Fluent-Asserts) directly relevant to engineering productivity
Strong technical breadth across web, mobile, embedded, and CI/CD infrastructure with 15+ years of experience
History of mentoring and teaching via workshops, talks, and Refactoring Dojos, showing knowledge-sharing inclination
concerns: No demonstrated people-management experience — all roles are individual contributor titles despite 'Staff' and 'Senior' labels
No evidence of leading organizational change, setting team priorities, or owning a technical roadmap at an org level
Frequent job changes (many roles under 2 years) could raise questions about stability in a leadership role requiring sustained team investment

key_factors.factor: No evidence of technical leadership translating to team/roadmap ownership
Strong developer tooling and testing infrastructure background
